name: goalz
description: Read and manage your Goalz football-manager account through a secure remote MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: Connect your own Goalz manager account to read your club, fixtures, and game data. Optional writes require the corresponding OAuth consent. Wappen generation creates a private, quota-limited preview that is not activated automatically.
defaultPrompt: Use Goalz to check my current team and training plan.
Use Goalz to review my fixtures or create a private Wappen preview when I ask.
